skill.name: Swarm Orchestration
skill.purpose: Manager rules for parallel specialist swarms, shared-memory sync, selective dispatch, 2-cycle retry, and canonical JSON placeholders.

owns: incomplete/failed agent retry (max 2 cycles per agent)
correction routing to the failed agent, not the whole swarm
does_not_own: publishing Jira before Governance PASS (Markdown is schema-projected by Markdown Renderer from JSON)

rules: If a specialist output is missing, incomplete, invalid, or status is failed/incomplete, the owning orchestrator retries THAT agent only.
Do not regenerate the entire swarm on a single agent failure.
After 2 failed retries, mark the agent failed, record owner + reason in shared memory, and escalate to Workflow Orchestrator / Governance.
Governance FAIL routes correction to the owning orchestrator; that orchestrator retries only the failed agent(s); then return to Governance. Workflow Orchestrator allows max 2 Governance cycles.
Never retry a skipped agent.
If subagenttool returns not found, retry with the exact workflow node label from exact_subagent_names — never invent snake_case aliases.
Orchestrator must not mark SUCCESS while any required hierarchy file is missing; retry the owning agent instead.

swarm_pattern: Create and maintain shared memory so parallel agents stay in sync.
Fan-in only complete (or explicitly skipped) specialist outputs.
Logical dependency order is enforced through shared memory even when agents are dispatched in parallel.

rules: Orchestrator creates the file before dispatch if missing.
Every specialist reads shared memory before writing.
Every specialist writes its slot and agent_status after finishing.

rules.Epic -> Feature -> FAC -> AAC: Feature Agent must not finalize until Epic IDs exist in shared memory; FAC and AAC must not finalize until Feature IDs exist.

rules: Story area agents must not generate unless their area is in selected_areas.
Story Decomposer runs first and writes selected_areas and skipped_areas with rationale.
Technical Story Orchestrator runs only selected area agents.
Unselected area agents must immediately return status=skipped, write no Story, and not consume retry budget.
Do not create a Story merely because an area agent exists on the graph.
Create each placeholder file even if empty so downstream agents have a stable path.
Non-backlog placeholders use {"schema_version":"2.0.0","status":"pending","items":[]}.
backlog.json uses the hierarchy skeleton (requirements/epics/features/fac/aac/stories/sac).
Canonical JSON is the source of truth. Markdown and Jira are projections only.
Jira projection only after Governance PASS. Markdown projection is owned by Markdown Renderer and must follow schema; JSON is source of truth.
Do not create random specialist JSON trees; merge into the hierarchy.
Canonical source of truth is the backlog FOLDER TREE under src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/ (not a single backlog.json).
Projections must never remove Epics; Epic counts must match canonical.

backlog_hierarchy.governing_rule: REQ → EPIC → FEAT → FAC → AAC → ST → SAC. Epic/Feature=WHAT; Technical Story=HOW; FAC/AAC=Feature-level; SAC=Story-level.
shape: Technical Story ST-### under Feature with area in [UI, BFF/API, Domain, Persistence, Messaging, Testing]
input_rules: Never claim uploaded Modernization Inputs are missing without searching the workspace.

success_gate.rule: Orchestrators must not mark SUCCESS if any required layer file is missing on disk.
success_gate.hierarchy: REQ → EPIC → FEAT → FAC → AAC → ST → SAC
success_gate.on_missing: retry owning exact-named agent only (max 2); then escalate failed; never fake PASS.
forbid_false_success: monolithic backlog.json as sole ST/SAC store
inline feature_acceptance_criteria without FAC-###.json / AAC-###.json files

rules: Projections must never remove, merge, rename, or omit any Epic from canonical backlog.
Projection Epic count must equal canonical Epic count.
On Governance FAIL do not delete existing projections/backlog/Epic content.

dispatch_map.note: subagenttool only works for workers wired to the CURRENT orchestrator via parent/subagent edges. Stage orchestrators are sequential graph nodes — never call them via subagenttool.

Workflow Orchestrator.rule: Sequential only. Finish handoff; graph advances to Current-State Orchestrator.

output_tree_lock.nested_shape: Requirement → Epic → Feature → FAC/AAC → Technical-Stories/ST-### → SAC

rules: JSON agents write schema-complete JSON under src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/ only. Markdown Renderer (Claude Sonnet 4.5) writes matching .md twins under src/artifacts/projections/backlog/. Do not dual-write Markdown from JSON agents.
JSON path root: src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/. Markdown path root: src/artifacts/projections/backlog/.
All skill schema required_fields must be present and non-empty before status=complete; otherwise status=incomplete and retry.
Never write under src/canonical/ or use flat Feature/FAC/AAC siblings of Epic.

schema_completeness_gate.rule: STRICT schema compliance — All output.required_fields must be present and non-empty before status=complete; never rename/drop/stub required fields
